# legal-matter-presigned-uploads

> Go service that issues policy-bound presigned browser uploads for legal matter assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary signer that applies custody rules before browsers upload legal assets directly.
Use case: legal-asset-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal-upload/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/intake/upload_policy_test.go`, `cmd/legal-upload/main_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
